newsitem.title: USA: Loral Space to buy AT&T satellite unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Loral Space to buy AT&T satellite unit - WSJ.

text.p: Loral Space & Communications Ltd is close to a deal to buy AT&T Corp's U.S. broadcast-satellite unit for more than $700 million, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
The deal to buy the four-satellite Skynet unit could be announced Wednesday, the Journal said.
Loral plans to invest at least another $700 million in the subsidiary in an effort to expand it into a major international player in the industry, the article said.
The two companies declined to comment on the article and were not immediately available to comment on it.
